description: NaSO₄H₂CF₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of four CF₃ clusters; four H₂ clusters; and one NaSO₄ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. In each CF₃ cluster, C is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three F atoms. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and two longer (1.35 Å) C-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.75 Å. In the NaSO₄ sheet, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.78 Å. S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.59 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.51 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one S, and one O atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom.
